COURSE TITLE    BUSINESS ENVIRONMENT
COURSE CODE     10BC2102
COURSE CREDITS  4

Objective:
 1  To impart basic understanding of the various types of environmental components
     influencing the business.
 2  To recognize opportunities, risks, and challenges and their relevance associated with
     managerial decisions
 3  To apply theoretical knowledge to real-world business scenarios, developing critical
     thinking and decision-making skills essential for managerial roles in diverse business
      settings.


Course Outcomes: After completion of this course, student will be able to:
 1  Understand the meaning and relationship of environment and business
 2  Determine the various political and economic factors affecting business.
 3  Analyse the legal framework affecting a business
 4   Critically evaluate the impact of the emerging technological environment on businesses,
     identifying opportunities and challenges presented by innovations
 5  Construct a comprehensive understanding of the multifaceted landscape of contemporary
     business operations


Pre-requisite of course:N/A

objectives: To provide a conceptual understanding of the basic principles of the Law of Contract
To develop analytical skills concerning various issues related to the law of Contract
To understand the judicial interpretation of the statute the case analysis method of teaching will be mostly adopted.
course_outcomes: Develop a conceptual understanding of the basics of the law of contract.
Understand the legal aspects of a valid contract and simultaneously judge a void and voidable contract.
Learn the remedies available in cases of breach of contract
Develop strong analytical skills to review, draft, and analyze a contract. Pre-requisite of course:N/A

COURSE TITLE    PRINCIPLES OF BUSINESS ADMINISTRATION
COURSE CODE     10BC2101
COURSE CREDITS  4

Objective:
 1  To understand the basic principles of management
 2  To examine the significance of establishing clear and measurable goals and objectives for
     organizational success.
 3  To provide an understanding of the managerial functions essential in today‘s business
    environment


Course Outcomes: After completion of this course, student will be able to:
 1  Demonstrate knowledge of business and management principles
 2  Get acquainted with management processes and functions
 3  Critique the process of directing, communication and coordination in management
 4  Comprehend the modern management techniques and its relevance in business
